latestVersion.changelog: Initial release: Complete guide for creating ClawHub skills that pass the security scanner. Covers frontmatter schema (all 3 env declaration formats), scanner compliance for all 5 categories, script safety patterns, config change documentation, publish workflow, and 3 ready-to-use templates. Documents the packager vs registry frontmatter discrepancy.
